title: Normalization Protocol for RNA Isolation
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Download file input template
steps.instruction: Download the file input template from https://opentrons-protocol-library-website.s3.amazonaws.com/custom-README-images/979d28-normalization/ex.csv.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: Navigate in the OT App to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and select your labware files with .json extensions if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT App, upload your protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck on the OT robot following the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate your labware, tiprack, and pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips.
